name: Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024
information: ## This is the FMC-Only competition of [Rubik's UK Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024) #### As FMC is not being held at [Rubik's UK Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024), this is your chance to become the UK's Fewest Moves Champion! The podiummers will be crowned during the awards ceremony the following week in Coventry* Please see all the tabs to see the locations and information of each venue. *\\* You do not need to attend UKC to become the UK FMC National Champion.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbng5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--153ecb54fb75b7956c0701cb174dca72201b0444/image.png)
